## Microsoft Dev Box  
  
<!--d5a312aa-50e9-49b9-b720-cf4f8d4b3e3b_begin-->

#### Migrate from Microsoft Dev Box to Windows 365  
  
Microsoft Dev Box is retiring. Migrate your workloads to Windows 365 for developer-focused capabilities, performance improvements, and simplified management.  
  
**Potential benefits**: Avoid potential disruptions  

**Impact:** Medium
  
For more information, see [Microsoft Dev Box retirement guide](/azure/dev-box/dev-box-retirement-guide)
